experiment.decisionAffected: This provider-free v3 turn decides only whether the repaired semantic contract, fresh development corpus, metrics, and archive path are coherent enough to seal. A later, separately authorized development execution could decide whether this assay distinguishes active self-review, valid critique derived from existing information, matched placebo criticism, and genuinely new decisive evidence. Neither this repair nor any future development result may change Task Monki product behavior, open confirmation, or advance to ABC.

hypotheses.exactHypothesis: For a live Sol/high first pass whose target remains wrong after active same-thread self-review, a fresh Sol/high response to a valid, anonymous, claim-targeted critique derived only from already visible case information corrects the target more often than both self-review and a fresh response to a matched false critique, while preserving correct guards and directly dispositioning the exact visible issue.
hypotheses.mechanismIsolated: Each derivable block shares one exact live typed DRAFT. Same-thread self-review gets no external signal. Valid- and placebo-critique arms use fresh threads with the same case and DRAFT, matched target, kind, severity, form, and no new facts. The valid-versus-placebo contrast isolates the content of error localization from generic challenge, target salience, authority, fresh identity, or an extra call; the valid-versus-self-review contrast tests whether another agent's content-specific critique adds information beyond active checking.
hypotheses.expectedDiscriminatingPattern: Every scheduled arm must produce one interpretable primary output. At least two blocks spanning both derivable cases must have a wrong live target that remains wrong after self-review. In each informative block the initial, self-review, and placebo outputs must have consistent typed issue and resolution accounting, and the self-review must accurately represent any public change or no-change result. The valid critique must yield the exact answer and target, preserve correct guards, explicitly accept or partially accept the exact issue when correction is needed, represent actual structured changes, and pass required, allowed, and resolution checks. The placebo critique must be directly rejected, must not be adopted, and must preserve guards. Because wrong controls are deliberately the efficacy contrast, their wrong target's evidence direction is retained as an error observation but is not an evidence-quality success condition. Correct initial or self-reviewed blocks remain observed but are ineligible for wrong-to-right critique efficacy rather than being counted as failures or removed from completeness accounting.
hypotheses.supportResult: The complete discriminating pattern occurs in every informative block without placebo adoption, right-to-wrong contamination, critique-as-factual-evidence use, missing required or known-disallowed evidence in the corrected valid-critique output, inconsistent typed issue accounting in any arm, inaccurate self-review change representation, invalid output, unavailable measurement, or boundary failure. Evidence attached to a deliberately wrong control target remains reported but does not make that control ineligible.
hypotheses.rejectResult: With a complete valid cohort and at least two informative blocks spanning both cases, any informative valid-critique arm that does not outperform both controls yields NO_CONTROLLED_CRITIQUE_SIGNAL. Fewer than two informative blocks spanning both cases yields ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE. Any missing, duplicate, structurally invalid, context-invalid, provenance-invalid, unavailable, or unstarted primary makes the causal result INCONCLUSIVE; parseable semantic noncompliance remains an observed failure and is not repaired.
hypotheses.decisionChanged: A clean development signal would permit only a separately preregistered critique-generation study. A ceiling stops further derivable-critique work on this assay. No controlled signal favors an equally funded self-review or fresh-response control. No outcome authorizes a product protocol, ABC, or confirmation.

hypotheses.exactHypothesis: When one named authoritative fact is absent, a provenance-labeled packet containing that genuinely new decisive fact moves a fresh Sol/high response from the exact underdetermined state to the exact resolved answer with directionally correct attribution, while the live first pass and active same-thread self-review remain open and make the correctly owned request.
hypotheses.mechanismIsolated: Each evidence block shares one exact live typed DRAFT. Self-review cannot obtain the missing fact. A fresh evidence response receives one typed FACTUAL_EVIDENCE packet containing raw data but no answer label. Exact packet id and evidence direction are required. One case requires a blocking USER request and the other a blocking DOCUMENT request without user escalation. Fresh identity is a limitation, but it cannot manufacture the opaque sealed evidence id or the exact missing fact.
hypotheses.expectedDiscriminatingPattern: All base and self-review outputs choose the exact cannot-determine option, keep the target UNRESOLVED, preserve guards, make exactly one correctly owned and sufficiently targeted structured request, and avoid unsupported closure. All evidence responses choose the exact resolved option, assess target and guards correctly, clear the request, cite the decisive packet in the required direction, and pass issue, evidence, and resolution audits. Required evidence is a minimum; additional references count as failures only where a non-null oracle allow-list establishes they are disallowed.
hypotheses.supportResult: All four complete evidence blocks satisfy the expected pattern without right-to-wrong contamination, unsupported closure, invalid typed provenance, missing required evidence, known-disallowed evidence, inconsistent issue accounting, terminal abstention, invalid output, unavailable measurement, or boundary failure.
hypotheses.rejectResult: A complete valid cohort that misses the all-block pattern yields EVIDENCE_ASSAY_FAILED. Any missing, duplicate, structurally invalid, context-invalid, provenance-invalid, unavailable, or unstarted primary yields INCONCLUSIVE. Unsupported definite closure or right-to-wrong contamination yields SAFETY_BLOCK. Parseable semantic omissions remain model outcomes rather than exclusions.
hypotheses.decisionChanged: A clean result qualifies only the repaired uncertainty, request, and controlled-evidence assay for a later evidence-acquisition study. Failure blocks escalation and requires locating the remaining defect in the case, prompt, schema, metric, model, or harness.

stoppingRules.rule: Never dispatch a twenty-ninth semantic provider call. No provider call is authorized during this v3 repair turn, and no schema-repair calls are permitted in any later execution.

In a future authorized execution, stop before the next block when provider-reported cumulative usage after a complete block is at least 300000 tokens. Preserve the crossing block and overshoot; never select observations by realized usage.

Each future call has one 120000 ms deadline shared by startup, thread creation, submission, and generation, followed only by the separately bounded interruption and usage-recovery window. Preserve partial text, usage, acknowledgement, latency, and stopping reason; do not retry semantic work.
Stop before dispatch when 2400000 ms has elapsed.
The 900-token value is a concision target, not censoring. At 25000 streamed output tokens request interruption, preserve overshoot and acknowledgement state, and stop the affected block.

Stop immediately on tools, MCP, browsing, repositories, tasks, instruction sources, model/effort/tier drift, rerouting, compaction, scorer leakage, continuation mismatch, fresh-thread reuse, or any other ordinary-text boundary violation.
Input, cached-input, output, reasoning, and total usage must be present after every started future turn before another assignment; missing usage stops fail-closed and is not imputed.
Stop after two consecutive pre-semantic provider failures, or immediately on ambiguous delivery or unconfirmed interruption. Preserve every failure without retrying semantic work.

There is no repair call. Retain each shape-invalid model output or typed output-reference/provenance violation as an invalid observation and stop after two consecutive invalid primaries. Do not infer failure type from condition labels, JSON paths, or message text. A typed harness context-definition inconsistency with measurementEffect MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE stops immediately under UNANSWERABLE_EXPERIMENT instead of being counted as model noncompliance.

Stop before further calls when a case, prompt, oracle, metric, typed provenance rule, session rule, or harness inconsistency makes the mechanism unanswerable or produces MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE. Diagnose and version the faulty layer instead of patching a live cohort.

Complete the sealed derivable cohort. If fewer than two blocks spanning both cases retain a wrong target after self-review, classify H1c-D ASSAY_NOT_INFORMATIVE; do not add replacement cases or rounds. Continue only the already sealed evidence blocks required for the independent evidence assay.
No repair result, development result, budget remainder, operational retry, or future harness change may create or run confirmation.

metricDefinitions.answer: selectedOptionIds is the sole structured answer authority. answer.summary is preserved as UNADJUDICATED_SUMMARY_ONLY and cannot establish full answer-text correctness.
metricDefinitions.uncertainty: Epistemic state, proposition assessment, completion action, request ownership, and unsupported definite closure are scored separately.
metricDefinitions.informationRequest: The oracle declares nonempty requiredPropositionIds as minimum coverage and allowedPropositionIds as a maximum only when non-null. Score exactly one request, kind, source owner, blocking state, required-target coverage, known-disallowed extra targets, and matching user action separately. A targeting error does not erase a correct USER-versus-DOCUMENT ownership or escalation measurement.
metricDefinitions.factualEvidence: requiredEvidenceAlternatives are minimum sufficient directional pairs. allowedEvidenceReferences is exhaustive only for the individual proposition where it is non-null. Null means additional references are UNADJUDICATED, not correct, forbidden, or absent. A FACTUAL_EVIDENCE packet's evidenceId cites its factual content; its artifactId is visible-artifact provenance only and cannot satisfy factual support. Critique and position artifacts are never factual sources.
metricDefinitions.critiqueProvenance: Typed artifact kind, artifact id, issue id, response link, and visibility determine conversational provenance. Every issue visible in the typed DRAFT is addressable. Validation and stop behavior use typed rule domains and measurement effects, never lexical path, message, case, or condition heuristics.
metricDefinitions.selfCorrection: A no-change self-review may report no issue and no correction. A claimed correction links a current typed DRAFT issue to exact stable proposition ids and structured fields actually changed. Mismatch is parseable semantic noncompliance unless the public shape itself is invalid.
metricDefinitions.resolution: Every typed DRAFT issue, current issue, and directly answered external issue must be accounted for exactly once as resolved or unresolved. Resolved disagreements are compatible with global RESOLVED; unresolved disagreement or issue is not. Rejected critiques may use NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE, or factual evidence when the response actually cites it. NO_DISAGREEMENT is inconsistent when a disagreement record exists.
metricDefinitions.criticism: Controlled valid- and placebo-critique dispositions are measured by opaque typed artifact and issue ids. Placebo acceptance is invented criticism. Unmatched spontaneous material issues are reported as unadjudicated rather than automatically labeled invented.
metricDefinitions.confidence: Confidence attaches to the structured answer characterization and each proposition assessment. High-confidence answer, epistemic, proposition, request, evidence, and contextual failures are reported separately.
metricDefinitions.abstention: Terminal ABSTAIN requires an abstention object and remains distinct from an OPEN or underdetermined answer. These cases are answerable at their correct epistemic level, so terminal abstention is inappropriate.
metricDefinitions.minorityPreservation: NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_SOCIAL_MINORITY_EXPOSURE. Target and guard preservation are safety checks, not a social-minority result.
metricDefinitions.eligibleDenominators: Every cohort metric reports planned, observed, valid, eligible, passed, failed, invalid, unavailable, and unstarted counts. Rates use eligible only. Invalid, unavailable, and unstarted observations never enter the eligible denominator, but any such observation fails the full-cohort completeness gate and makes the causal result INCONCLUSIVE. Informative wrong-to-right critique efficacy additionally requires a wrong target that remains wrong after self-review; ceiling cases remain valid observed outputs but are ineligible for that mechanism rate.
metricDefinitions.exclusions: Provider failures are unavailable; duplicate or shape-invalid outputs and typed output-reference or provenance violations are invalid. A typed harness context-definition inconsistency is MEASUREMENT_UNAVAILABLE, never model noncompliance. Every category is recorded and none is silently dropped. Evidence, resolution, answer, request, confidence, abstention, and correction mistakes in an otherwise interpretable output remain eligible scored failures.

causalLimitations: Hand-authored signal generation cost is excluded, so this cannot establish end-to-end product or equal-dollar superiority.

Self-review is same-thread while critique and evidence responses are fresh-thread. The matched placebo critique diagnoses generic fresh-response and challenge effects for critique, but the evidence assay has no fresh no-packet arm.
Four fresh development cases with two repetitions qualify an assay; they do not estimate general-world effect sizes.
Provider sampling seeds are unsupported; every session, setting, usage count, latency, failure, overshoot, invalid output, unavailable measurement, and exclusion must be retained.
Free-form answer and request prose is not semantically adjudicated. Claims about prose quality require a separate treatment-blind rubric.
The H1c-v1 and H1c-v2 archives remain frozen and INCONCLUSIVE. Treatment-blind defect adjudication informed harness engineering only and is not causal evidence.

No provider execution is authorized by this preregistration turn. A future run requires an independently validated zero-provider H0 receipt, exact source locks and seals, a fresh passed exact-model boundary probe, and explicit user authorization.
